sections.title: باب 1 — متن (92)

paras.text: … lead our lives in such a way that we avoid dishonesty in them. Let us consider testimony a trust, and when the time comes, neither conceal it nor make any increase or decrease in it. At every moment let us have this faith, that Allah is watching us and all our deeds are being written. On the Day of Judgement we will have to give account of each and every deed. If we lead our lives according to the commands of Allah and His Messenger, then we will be admitted into Paradise. But if we turn away from the commands of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, then we will have to face the displeasure of Allah. May Allah the Exalted grant us all the ability to do good deeds.
paras.urdu: زندگی اس طرح بسر کریں کہ اس میں بددیانتی سے بچیں۔ گواہی کو امانت سمجھیں اور وقت آنے پر اسے نہ تو چھپائیں اور نہ ہی اس میں کمی بیشی کریں۔ ہر وقت یہ ایمان رکھیں کہ اللہ ہمیں دیکھ رہا ہے اور ہمارے تمام اعمال لکھے جا رہے ہیں۔ قیامت کے روز ہمیں اپنے ہر ہر عمل کا حساب دینا پڑے گا۔ اگر ہم نے اللہ اور اس کے رسول کے احکامات کے مطابق زندگی گزاری ہوگی تو ہمیں جنت میں داخل کر دیا جائے گا۔ لیکن اگر ہم نے اللہ اور اس کے رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم کے احکامات سے روگردانی کی ہوگی تو پھر ہمیں اللہ کی ناراضگی کا سامنا کرنا پڑے گا۔ اللہ تعالیٰ ہم سب کو نیک عمل کرنے کی توفیق عطا فرمائے۔

… lead our lives in such a way that we avoid dishonesty in them. Let us consider testimony a trust, and when the time comes, neither conceal it nor make any increase or decrease in it. At every moment let us have this faith, that Allah is watching us and all our deeds are being written. On the Day of Judgement we will have to give account of each and every deed. If we lead our lives according to the commands of Allah and His Messenger, then we will be admitted into Paradise. But if we turn away from the commands of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, then we will have to face the displeasure of Allah. May Allah the Exalted grant us all the ability to do good deeds.

Verse no. 285

اٰمَنَ الرَّسُوْلُ بِمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّهٖ وَالْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ ؕ كُلٌّ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَلٰٓئِكَتِهٖ وَكُتُبِهٖ وَرُسُلِهٖ ۟ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ رُّسُلِهٖ ۟ وَقَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا ۗ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ

Translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ believes in that Book which was sent down upon him from his Lord, and the believers too. All believe in Allah, in His angels, in His Books and in His messengers, and they say: we make no distinction between any of His messengers; and they submit to Allah: we heard Your command and accepted it. O Lord, we ask Your forgiveness, and to You alone is the return.

Explanation

In this noble verse the articles of faith are mentioned. All the messengers sent down from Allah the Exalted are links of one and the same chain. All were sinless; all gave the invitation to tawhid, and all believed in the finality of prophethood of the last of all, the Prophet of the Last Age, Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ. Believers are only those who believe in all the noble prophets. They are not like the Jews and Christians who believe in some and deny some. The people of faith believe first of all in Allah the Exalted, that He is the Creator …

paras.text: … and Owner. He has been from eternity and will remain till eternity. He is One, without partner. He has power over everything and is the Master of the Day of the Hereafter. Believers also believe in the angels of Allah, that they are the creation of Allah. At all times they remain busy in worship and are free from sins. They also have certainty in all the heavenly Books, and also believe in those scriptures which Allah the Exalted sent down upon various prophets for the guidance of human beings. Believers also believe in all the prophets and do not differentiate between any of them. However, some prophets have superiority over others, just as our Master and Lord Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ is the leader of all prophets and messengers.
paras.urdu: و مالک ہے۔ ازل سے ہے اور ابد تک رہے گا۔ وہ وحدہٗ لاشریک ہے۔ ہر چیز پر قادر ہے اور یومِ آخرت کا مالک ہے۔ مومن لوگ اللہ کے فرشتوں پر بھی ایمان لاتے ہیں کہ وہ اللہ کی مخلوق ہیں۔ ہمہ وقت عبادت میں مصروفِ عمل رہتے ہیں اور گناہوں سے پاک ہیں۔ تمام آسمانی کتابوں پر بھی یقین رکھتے ہیں اور ان صحیفوں پر بھی ایمان لاتے ہیں جو اللہ تعالیٰ نے انسانوں کی ہدایت کے لیے مختلف انبیاء پر نازل فرمائے تھے۔ مومن لوگ تمام انبیاء پر بھی ایمان رکھتے ہیں اور کسی میں فرق نہیں رکھتے البتہ بعض انبیاء بعض پر فضیلت رکھتے ہیں جس طرح ہمارے آقا و مولیٰ حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم تمام انبیاء اور رسولوں کے سردار ہیں۔

paras.text: In this verse this quality of the believers too has been stated, that after believing they pray to Allah that He forgive them and grant them His pardon. They hear the commands of Allah and accept them with their hearts, that is, act upon them. We should act upon all the commands of Allah the Exalted and also keep asking Him for forgiveness.

… and Owner. He has been from eternity and will remain till eternity. He is One, without partner. He has power over everything and is the Master of the Day of the Hereafter. Believers also believe in the angels of Allah, that they are the creation of Allah. At all times they remain busy in worship and are free from sins. They also have certainty in all the heavenly Books, and also believe in those scriptures which Allah the Exalted sent down upon various prophets for the guidance of human beings. Believers also believe in all the prophets and do not differentiate between any of them. However, some prophets have superiority over others, just as our Master and Lord Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ is the leader of all prophets and messengers.

In this verse this quality of the believers too has been stated, that after believing they pray to Allah that He forgive them and grant them His pardon. They hear the commands of Allah and accept them with their hearts, that is, act upon them. We should act upon all the commands of Allah the Exalted and also keep asking Him for forgiveness.

… and Owner. He has been from eternity and will remain till eternity. He is One, without partner. He has power over everything and is the Master of the Day of the Hereafter. Believers also believe in the angels of Allah, that they are the creation of Allah. At all times they remain busy in worship and are free from sins. They also have certainty in all the heavenly Books, and also believe in those scriptures which Allah the Exalted sent down upon various prophets for the guidance of human beings. Believers also believe in all the prophets and do not differentiate between any of them. However, some prophets have superiority over others, just as our Master and Lord Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ is the leader of all prophets and messengers.

In this verse this quality of the believers too has been stated, that after believing they pray to Allah that He forgive them and grant them His pardon. They hear the commands of Allah and accept them with their hearts, that is, act upon them. We should act upon all the commands of Allah the Exalted and also keep asking Him for forgiveness.

اس آیت میں مومنوں کی یہ صفت بھی بیان کی گئی ہے کہ وہ ایمان لانے کے بعد اللہ سے دعا کرتے ہیں کہ انہیں بخش دے اور ان کی مغفرت فرما دے۔ وہ اللہ کے احکامات کو سنتے ہیں اور دل سے مانتے ہیں یعنی ان پر عمل کرتے ہیں۔ ہمیں چاہیے کہ ہم اللہ تعالیٰ کے تمام احکامات پر عمل کریں اور اس سے مغفرت کی دعا بھی مانگتے رہیں۔
